name: SignGraph is pure-functional and imports only Metrologic, SignCell and SignChain
asks: The Sign libraries are pure-functional and everything else is built downstream of them.

met-when.says: package.json lists exactly three dependencies, @red-cup-engineering/metrologic, @red-cup-engineering/signcell and @red-cup-engineering/signchain, and no peer or optional dependency.
No module under src/ imports any other package, any Node.js built-in module, or any file outside src/.

No module under src/ reads a clock, a random source, the environment, a file or the network, or writes to anything outside its return value. A store, a clock or a model call reaches SignGraph only as a function argument.
Every exported function returns a deeply equal, frozen value when called twice with the same arguments.

sources.words: The Sign libraries are pure-functional and everything else is built downstream of them.
first metrologic, then signcell, then signchain, then signgraph, then signcraft
sources.from: the Leader's order of the family, quoted in computer-engineering-services-section content/text/documents/specifications/2026-11-07-rebuilding-the-sign-family-from-its-theory.md
